units.source: kal'-fi (Chalphi; the King James Version Calphi): Father of Judas, who, along with Mattathias, steadily supported Jonathan at the battle of Gennesar when the hosts of Demetrius' princes were routed (1 Macc 11:70).

units.source: kar'-mis (Charmeis, Charmeis, A, Chalmeis): The son of Melchiel, one of the three elders or rulers of the town of Bethulia (Judith 6:15; 8:10; 10:6).

units.source: kas'-e-ba (Chaseba): The name of a family of temple-servants in the list of those who returned from Babylon (1 Esdras 5:31). The name is not given in the parallel passages in Ezra and Nehemiah.
units.target: kas'-e-ba (Chaseba) : Nom d'une famille de serviteurs du Temple dans la liste de ceux qui revinrent de Babylone (1 Esdras 5.31). Ce nom ne figure pas dans les passages parallèles d'Esdras et de Néhémie.
